result.title: $O(1/n)$ Convergence Rate for RVI $Q$-Learning
result.summary: We establish finite-time convergence guarantee for synchronous relative value iteration (RVI) $Q$-learning for finite weakly communicating Markov decision processes (MDPs). For stochastic Krasnosel'skiĭ--Mann iterations driven by a non-expansive, linearly regular map on a finite-dimensional normed space, we establish last-iterate mean-squared residual bounds under martingale-difference noise whose conditional second moment grows at most linearly with the squared residual. Suitable polynomial stepsizes of order $n^{-a}$ yield an $O(n^{-a})$ rate for $0<a\leq1$. We verify linear regularity and the noise condition for the centered Bellman operator for finite weakly communicating MDPs. Applying the general result gives an $O(n^{-1})$ bound on the mean-squared Bellman span residual of RVI $Q$-learning iterates when a suitable stepsize sequence is used. The positive gap between optimal and suboptimal stationary deterministic policies then yields an $O(n^{-1})$ bound on the expected suboptimality of the greedy policy. Consequently, $O(ε^{-1})$ synchronous iterations suffice for an $ε$-optimal policy in expectation. These guarantees are instance-dependent, with constants that depend on the hitting-time parameters and the suboptimality gap of the second-best policy.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文为有限弱通信 MDP 上的同步相对值迭代（RVI）Q-learning 建立有限时间收敛率：先对非扩张、线性正则映射驱动的随机 Krasnosel'skiĭ–Mann 迭代给出末迭代均方残差界，再推出 O(1/n) 的 Bellman span 残差与贪心策略期望次优性界，并给出 O(ε^{-1}) 迭代复杂度。
